Dimensius the All-Devouring ( ) is one of the Void lords, monstrous entities composed of pure shadow energy who rule over the Void, outside the borders of reality. Thousands of years ago, he tried to consume the worldsoul of K'aresh, the homeworld of the K'areshi, who later became the ethereals and brokers. During the Devouring War, however, he was stopped and split into multiple fragments across the cosmos when the Ravel, a secret K'areshi organization, triggered the destruction of their planet in a desperate attempt to kill him. .]] The Discs of Tyr (or simply the disc of Tyr) are a titanic artifact holding a record of Keeper Tyr's memories. Having anticipated his death to the servants of Loken, Keeper Tyr had crafted a disc containing his memories and entrusted it to Sentinel Talondras, who safeguarded it within the depths of Uldaman until the arrival of Archaedas and Ironaya. They were then instructed to give the Discs of Tyr to the Dragon Aspects and tell them what to do when the time was right. During the war against the Primalists in 40 ADP, Alexstrasza sought the discs to restore Tyr, as he and the titans were the only ones to know how restore their Aspects powers. The Dragon Tower is a structure in Warcraft Rumble. Dragon Towers are placed across the map in strategic locations, typically starting in control of the enemy AI. They are deploy zones, similar to the Barracks and Meeting Stones. Unlike the Meeting Stone, they will defend themselves when attacked and must be destroyed and rebuilt to be claimed. Though this can be a challenge, it also allows the player to set up a stable forward position on the map for themselves -- unlike Meeting Stones which can be taken by the enemy simply walking by them. , a night elf druid in the .]] Druidism (or the druidic arts) is a nature-centered spiritual tradition focused on preserving balance between all living things and the natural world. It is much more than a fighting discipline; it's a way of life steeped in traditions so ancient that even the origin of their kind is preserved largely in mythology passed on through millennia. The druids' magic derives from nature, enabling them to channel natural energies and transform into animals. They maintain a deep connection to nature through the Emerald Dream, a primordial realm that encompasses all aspects of nature.

Ecological Stability is a quest achievement earned by ensuring all the creatures in the Oasis are fully integrated into the ecosystem. This is one of the criteria of the meta-achievement Ecological Succession. Earning this achievement will have Ve'nari start The Hope of K'aresh, which awards the Resplendent K'arroc mount. To do this, complete daily and weekly quests at the Oasis and interact with the Oasis Console to see progress. Each species has ten levels of progress: # This species is limited in its impact upon the ecosystem due to a low population. # The species has settled in the Oasis. The first signs of a response to its presence are being noticed. # The species has started to expand
